name: condensing_boiler_refsim
title: Condensing boiler reference model (RefSim)
summary: Reference simulation model of a condensing boiler of the ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage): a supposed adiabatic combustion chamber described by five fictitious processes (cooling of the air and of the fuel to the reference temperature, stoichiometric combustion, CO2-CO dissociation of the air excess, heating of the products), a counter-flow dry gas-water heat exchanger (epsilon-NTU), a cooling coil standing for the wet gas-water exchanger in which the fumes condense (solved as fully dry and as fully wet, the regime of highest cooling power being kept) and a semi-isothermal water-environment exchanger standing for the heat losses to the ambient; the mean specific heat of the combustion products comes from the cpbar function of the bank.
language_features: ideal-gas substances (CO2, H2O, O2, N2, CH4, C2H6, C3H8, C4H10)

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), heat production by combustion, condensing boiler reference simulation model, 9 January 2008

verification.summary: At the operating point of the stored EES solution: 225 common variables, 80 differ (rtol=0.001), mostly from a stale stored solution and moist-air properties. Useful power, efficiencies and water temperature agree to better than 2e-05.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (243 of its 258 variable records hold a value); the model runs the operating point of that stored solution (x_load 0.37, T_w_su_boil 30 C, V_dot_w_boil_ls 5.6 l/s, T_amb 20 C)
verification.notes: 225 common variables, 80 differ above rtol=0.001 (the 6 absolute fuel enthalpies h_CH4_*, h_C2H6_*, h_C3H8_* are older JANAF-type values of the EES 7.888 file; no result is affected; h_C4H10_* differ by 2.8e-03 for the same reason). Maximum relative difference 0.75 on ratio_loss, a consequence of the stale AU_wenv of the stored solution (see below). All the results of the boiler agree to better than 2e-05: Q_dot_u_boil 106671.004 / 106670.473 W (5e-06), eta_HHV 0.978721 / 0.978704 (1.8e-05), T_w_ex_boil 34.5739 / 34.5734 C (1.4e-05), M_dot_f_boil_kgh and M_dot_g_boil_kgh identical. The remaining differences: (a) the stored EES solution is stale (CS-BUG-EXTRACT-STALE): it uses a_gw = 0.62 (AU_gw = 310*(0.04060649/0.09423)^0.62 = 183.9474 W/K is the stored value, while the equations window has 0.65, which gives 179.36), R_a_coil_n = 0.003 K/W (R_a_coil = 0.0056699 K/W stored, 0.0047249 with the 0.0025 of the file), R_m_coil = 1e-4 K/W and AU_wenv = 0.5 W/K (Q_dot_wenv 7.2868 W stored, 29.149 W with the 2 W/K of the file) - this family accounts for epsilon_gw (+3.4e-03), Q_dot_gw (-2.9e-03), Q_dot_coil (+2.5e-02), Q_dot_sens_coil (+1.1e-01) and ratio_loss; re-running the variant with those four parameters gives Q_dot_u_boil 106660.6 W (-9e-05), eta_HHV 0.978626 (-8e-05), T_w_ex_boil 34.57344 C, Q_dot_coil 11888.4 W (+4.8e-04), Q_dot_wenv 7.28680 W (2e-08) and 43 differing variables; (b) moist-air properties of EES 7.888 vs CoolProp (c_p_a_coil +1.1e-02, c_p_a_su_coil +8.3e-03, c_p_a_ex_coil_dry +2.1e-02, T_wb_su_coil +2.4e-03, W_a_ex_coil_dry +9.7e-03, h_a_su_coil +8.7e-03); (c) RH_a_ex_coil_dry (1.55e-01 with the parameter set of the stored solution) is a diagnostic output of the dry regime which feeds no equation when the wet regime is selected. No reference variable excluded: the 18 variables only in the EES reference are the local variables of the cpbar FUNCTION, the 33 only in the CoolSolve solution the internal variables of the flattened coil, the state points of the diagrams and the diagnostic variables. Re-checked with CoolSolve 0.3.0@4798e2b: the native file (C%, H%, molarmass(C4H10), enthalpy(C4H10), five-argument IF) solves in 28 iterations at the stored operating point and reproduces the earlier runnable variant in all 258 variables (except the C4H10 enthalpies the variant had replaced by 0).
